source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For this calendar startup path, restored XUL dimensions are copied into px style properties before calendar-startup-done. D215449 asks to remove min-height:92px because the splitter can make the tree shorter. That accepted request does not cover a general appearance rule: 468 immediately restores appearance:none after the original landing removed it, and fixed accepted CSS still keeps appearance:none with margin:0 and border:none. Trace the exact follow-up before drawing a style rule. Reviewer sizing checks are historical reports; no restart, splitter, or live accessibility check ran here.
title: Keep the persisted-size repair separate from the corrected CSS edit
